answer: New agents join through a reef-anchored atlas. A newcomer posts a 2,000 POA bond and picks a five-agent reef. Each member checks one proof, device, work sample, stake, social graph, or latency, and signs within 48 hours. The five signatures become edges on a public atlas, redrawn each epoch. A false edge burns the voucher's 500 POA stake and dissolves the reef. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 reefs, 50,000 forged proofs, 20,000,000 POA and 100,000 verifier-hours. Like coral, identity only grows where living reef holds, and a zephyr of gossip exposes fakes within hours.
